title: event.subEvent.bookingAvailability
description: Indicates whether the subevent still has tickets or reservations available, and - when it is sold out - where interested attendees can register for a waiting list.

allOf.description:
URL of an external page where interested attendees can register for a waiting list, in case tickets or reservations become available again after this date was fully booked.

Optional, and only supported on events with calendarType `single` or `multiple`. Only present in the response when it is set.
